answer: In a decentralized proof-of-agent blockchain protocol, karst-like economic cliffs deter Sybil attacks by imposing steep financial penalties. Mirror committed staking requires validators to stake twice their nominal stake, doubling the cost for malfeasance. Oasis reputation mechanisms incentivize honest behavior through verifiable delay functions, ensuring that the economic cost of a Sybil attack, including the time and capital lockup, far outweighs any potential gain, sustaining Byzantine Fault Tolerance.
